lines.cap: Your dog isn't being dirty when he humps.
lines.say: Your dog isn't being dirty when he humps.

lines.cap: A guest sits down. And the dog grabs their leg. Awkward.
lines.say: A guest sits down. And the dog grabs their leg. Awkward.

lines.cap: But most of the time, it has nothing to do with mating. Even neutered males and females do it.
lines.say: But most of the time, it has nothing to do with mating. Even neutered males and females do it.

lines.cap: Often it's play. Too much excitement, and nowhere to put it.
lines.say: Often it's play. Too much excitement, and nowhere to put it.

lines.cap: Sometimes it's stress, or a way to get your attention. Because it works. Everyone reacts.
lines.say: Sometimes it's stress, or a way to get your attention. Because it works. Everyone reacts.

lines.cap: Some dogs just have a favourite pillow. It feels good, so they do it.
lines.say: Some dogs just have a favourite pillow. It feels good, so they do it.

lines.cap: The fix? Stay calm. Calmly move them off, then give them something better to do, like a toy or a sit.
lines.say: The fix? Stay calm. Calmly move them off, then give them something better to do, like a toy or a sit.

lines.cap: If it suddenly starts a lot, ask a vet. It can sometimes be a sign of an itch or a problem down there.
lines.say: If it suddenly starts a lot, ask a vet. It can sometimes be a sign of an itch or a problem down there.

lines.cap: So relax. He's not being dirty. He's just over excited.
lines.say: So relax. He's not being dirty. He's just over excited.
